title: Git Worktrees — git_worktree
text: Worktrees represent alternative location checkout branch . Rather checking branch main working tree (changes branch currently forces stash existing work), can instead check branch separate linked worktree working tree. Practically, worktree just separate folder branch checked , extra git metadata links back main working tree. git_worktree_list() returns data frame information worktrees linked main working tree. git_worktree_exists() lets check whether worktree name name exists repo. git_worktree_path() returns file path worktree. git_worktree_add() creates new worktree called name folder pointed path, checks branch . git_worktree_remove() removes worktree. deleting folder provided path git_worktree_add(), cleaning git metadata main working tree linked main working tree removed worktree. branch checked worktree deleted. Note just wrapper around git_worktree_prune() sets desirable defaults aggressive removal. git_worktree_prune() cautious git_worktree_remove(). refuses prune valid locked worktrees default, also refuses delete working tree worktree default (.e. folder path). automatically run git periodic intervals prune outdated worktrees. interactive usage, typically want git_worktree_remove() instead. git_worktree_is_prunable() lets check worktree prunable given options. git_worktree_lock(), git_worktree_unlock(), git_worktree_is_locked() help manage whether worktree locked. worktree locked, automatically cleaned git_worktree_prune() (git ) periodic intervals, even looks invalid. typically useful worktree hard drive always connected (can make look invalid disconnected, typically making candidate automatic pruning). git_worktree_is_valid() checks whether worktree valid . valid worktree requires git data structures inside main working tree worktree present.
